programs.description: With invasive species invading Florida, it is up to animal control officers to deal with and get rid of the invading animals. Green iguanas, Nile monitors, rock pythons and Burmese pythons are among the most common species entering the Sunshine State. An elite squad of hunters, known as the Python Hunters, is fighting back. The Python Hunters are tasked with protecting the local environment by getting the invasive species under control. It's an important conservation mission and, if it fails, one of America's most-important ecosystems may never be able to recover.

Only the strongest survive in the animal kingdom, where the competition for food, territory or mates means employing skillfully crafted tricks of the trade. "Animal Armory" incorporates high-end imagery and computer graphics to reveal how wildlife use their teeth, claws, antlers, camouflage, venom and even spit to threaten and intimidate rivals and predators alike. With weapons of deception, animals disarm and entice prey to their death. Meanwhile, perhaps the oldest weapons employed by animals are projectiles, which have evolved into their own versions of poison-tipped harpoons, chemical missiles and high-powered bullets.

With invasive species invading Florida, it is up to animal control officers to deal with and get rid of the invading animals. It's an important conservation mission and, if it fails, one of America's most-important ecosystems may never be able to recover.
